english.title: Member of registered society's committee fail take steps to secure true and fair view of two or more revenue accounts

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: cooperative and community benefit societies act 2014

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a member of a registered society's committee, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NAME OF THE REGISTERED SOCIETY'S COMMITTEE..), failed to take all reasonable steps to secure that revenue accounts of the society, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NAME OF THE REGISTERED SOCIETY..), to which section 80(2) of the Co-operative and Community Benefit Societies Act 2014 applied, complied with that subsection in that where two or more revenue accounts were prepared in respect of the registered society for a year of account, the accounts when considered together did not give a true and fair view of the income and expenditure of the society as a whole for that year
english.legislation: Contrary to section 80(4)(b) of the Co-operative and Community Benefit Societies Act 2014.

english.notes: Section 80(5) provides that no offence is committed if the person had reasonable grounds to believe, and did believe, that a competent and reliable person was charged with the duty of securing that section 80(1) was complied with and was in a position to discharge that duty.
